title: Hula Hut Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Hula Hut, 300 feet to the beach, designer touches, and furnishings throughout the home—unforgettable vacation experience with an amazing location! Seaside, FL!
description_expanded: Description72 PENSACOLA STREETKING, QUEEN, 2 XL TWINSWelcome to Hula Hut | A Family-Friendly Seaside EscapeRecently renovated and full of laid-back coastal charm, Hula Hut is a surfer-chic beach cottage perfectly positioned on Pensacola Street in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Sleeping six guests comfortably, this family-friendly home is just 300 feet from the beach, a 2-minute walk to the Pensacola Pavilion private beach access, and equally close to the Seaside West Side Pool. Downtown Seaside’s iconic shops and restaurants are only two blocks away, making this an unbeatable location for a carefree coastal getaway.Shaded by mature oak and magnolia trees, this corner-lot cottage offers both privacy and proximity—ideal for guests who want to enjoy Seaside’s walkable lifestyle while staying tucked into a peaceful residential setting.Inviting Outdoor Spaces & Private ParkingGuests will appreciate the convenience of off-street parking in a private driveway, allowing for easy arrivals and departures. The home’s open-air front porch welcomes you with a charming bench swing and two chairs—perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or planning your next beach day beneath the shade of the trees.Additional outdoor amenities include a rear side deck with seating for two, a charcoal grill, and an enclosed outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off after sandy beach days.Open-Concept Living with Coastal StyleStep inside to a bright and airy first floor featuring high ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open, communal layout designed for gathering. The spacious living area includes a large sofa, two club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen Smart TV—creating a comfortable hub for movie nights, board games, or relaxed evenings together.The adjacent dining space features a farmhouse-style wood table with seating for six, seamlessly connecting to the fully renovated kitchen. The kitchen showcases quartz stone countertops, custom cabinetry, and fun, high-end blue retro appliances that add personality while offering modern performance.Comfortable Bedrooms & Ensuite BathsThe first-floor bedroom offers two XL twin beds and an ensuite full bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower—perfect for kids or guests who prefer main-level accommodations.Upstairs, the king primary suite provides a private retreat with a mounted Smart TV, generous closet space, and an ensuite bathroom featuring a single vanity and tub/shower combination. The third bedroom is a bright queen suite, surrounded by windows and complete with its own private ensuite bathroom with a tub and shower combination.Both upstairs bedrooms share access to a furnished open-air porch, complete with two hanging swings and additional seating—an ideal spot for evening wine, people-watching, or enjoying the coastal breeze from above.Thoughtful Amenities for a Relaxed StayAdditional conveniences include a stackable washer and dryer located in a designated laundry closet off the front foyer, making longer stays effortless. Every detail of Hula Hut has been designed to balance comfort, style, and Seaside’s easygoing charm.Your Perfect Seaside ResetWith a prime Pensacola Street location, close proximity to the beach, pool, and town center, and a thoughtfully renovated interior, Hula Hut is the perfect place to unwind, reconnect, and soak in the Seaside lifestyle. Whether you’re heading to the beach, strolling downtown, or relaxing on the porch swings, this cheerful cottage delivers the ultimate Seaside escape.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,492 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Pensacola Pavilion377 feet | 2-minute walk to beach accessWasher & dryerFreestanding ice makerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeCommunity amenities access including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking – 2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002426
